dedupe_keys.name: inference of dynamic origin destination matrices with trip and transfer status from individual smart card data

description: The developed software infers origin-destination matrices from incomplete fare validations and adds trip, transfer, walking and waiting statistics. Spatial/temporal granularity, calendar rules, passenger profiles and visualization preferences are parameterized. It is evaluated on CARRIS and METRO in Lisbon and identifies vulnerable OD pairs. The 2022 article reports 77.3 percent high-confidence bus alighting estimates; an earlier related thesis/conference description reports 70 percent and an additional multimodal improvement, which are retained as different reported results. The tool is implemented, but public software access is not established, and its underlying validations remain NDA-restricted. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-by-4.0. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened. It models network flow through inferred passenger journeys.
